def _pretty_statistics(statistics: Dict[str, Dict[str, int]], sig_figs: int
    =3, hide_zero: bool=False) ->Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]:
    out_stats = {}
    for mod, stats in statistics.items():
        out_stats[mod] = {}
        for stat_name, value in stats.items():
            if hide_zero and value == 0:
                out_stats[mod][stat_name] = ""
            else:
                out_stats[mod][stat_name] = _format_size(value, sig_figs, hide_zero)
    return out_stats
